title: Import resources
description: Review skills, agents, instructions and MCP configurations from other editors or a GitHub repository before preparing them in Rey30 IDvj.
desktopOnly: Resource import is available in the desktop application.
deviceInstructions: Open GitHub authorization and enter this code. Waiting for your authorization.
noRepos: No matching repositories in the loaded list.
noResources: No compatible resources found in this source.
renamed: A new name will preserve the existing resource.
reviewOnly: Available for review; cannot be imported automatically.
prepareNotice: Only selected resources will be prepared. Existing resources remain in place. Availability in chat depends on the agent features supported by this version.
mcpInactive: Imported MCP servers are disabled. Review their configuration and activate them from MCP settings when ready.
connectAfterImport: Connect and check MCP after import
connectNotice: Connecting runs the selected MCP commands or contacts their servers. Review their configuration first.
mcpChecked: Connection results are shown below. Use MCP settings to review or change each server.
missingMCP: The saved configuration for {{name}} could not be found.
notConnectedMCP: {{name}} did not appear in the connected server list.
stopFailed: The server could not be stopped after the failed check. Review MCP settings.

saveFailed: The configuration could not be saved. Your current configuration has been kept.
restartFailed: The configuration was saved, but {{name}} could not reconnect. Check its MCP status.
